subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: Should maintainers sponsor the confirmed isolated-writable `workspaceAccess: "none"` fix now as a security-reviewed sandbox boundary change, or fold it into broader custom-bind work?
rationale: A maintainer comment has clarified the intended `none` semantics, but the code change still broadens sandbox-local write behavior and must be reviewed as a sandbox security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Isolated-Writable Fix
options.body: Implement only sandbox-owned `/workspace` writability for `none`, keeping the real workspace unmounted and custom-bind semantics for separate issues.

options.title: Fold Into Custom-Bind Design
options.body: Delay this change until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59718 defines a single mount-aware write policy for isolated workspaces and custom binds.

options.title: Reconsider Read-Only None
options.body: Keep current read-only `none` behavior and update docs/support guidance, accepting that the recent maintainer comment would need to be superseded.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Isolated-Writable Fix
recommendation.body: Implement only sandbox-owned `/workspace` writability for `none`, keeping the real workspace unmounted and custom-bind semantics for separate issues.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the latest explicit maintainer direction on the sandbox `none` contract and have central history on the mount helper.
